scientific_integrity: Exact arithmetic with two full simplex predicates, two complete acyclic matchings and unit-minor proof; no independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complete reduced integral homology for the 18-arc bidirected triangular prism only. Does not classify homotopy type or larger graph families. Previous bidirected K3,3 calculation used as comparison, not newly claimed. Exhaustive finite arithmetic is reproducible; an equivalent unindexed source remains possible.
title: Integral multipath homology of the bidirected triangular prism
